dedupe_keys.name: dataset of optimal cement based panels enhanced with microencapsulated phase change material for energyplus simulations

description: Facundo Bre, Antonio Caggiano and Eddie Koenders publish EnergyPlus models and optimisation results for cement-based panels containing microencapsulated phase-change material. The dataset comprises the BESTEST Case 900 baseline and three improved designs, two XLSX Pareto-front workbooks, and the Sofia typical meteorological year used in the simulations. These are simulation models and calculated design alternatives, not monitored building savings. Zenodo provides seven files freely under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is the Sofia climate applied to an ASHRAE benchmark building, with weather labelled TMYx.2004-2018. The related article describes the thermophysical panel study. A limitation is that the native metadata does not define every Pareto-front variable, unit or optimisation constraint. Model files and workbook values were not opened, so numerical performance and reproducibility remain unverified.
